headlines.title: Whistleblower says USPS system Trump ordered for mail ballots is flawed and untested
headlines.description: An executive order from Trump, which is stymied in the courts, required the Postal Service to rapidly build a complex system to vet mail ballots.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy jurors are deadlocked, judge sends them back for more deliberations
headlines.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial told the judge Tuesday morning that it was unable to come to a unanimous decision at the start of a fourth day of deliberations.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: SCOTUS Green Lights Trump Ballroom; Army Secretary to Resign
headlines.description: Secretary of the Army, Dan Driscoll, is expected to step down after repeated clashes with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the war in Iran, the direction of the military and national security. Meanwhile, construction is moving forward at the White House after the Supreme Court allowed President Donald Trump to keep building his massive ballroom without congressional approval. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: U.S. military doesn’t plan to deploy troops to the polls in November, general says
headlines.description: Responding to a senator’s questions, Gen. Dan Caine said the Pentagon doesn’t plan to send military personnel to voting sites or to seize ballots or voting machines.

headlines.title: Death Toll Rises in Grand Canyon Floods; 1 Hiker Remains Missing
headlines.description: Authorities are bringing in more resources as they try to track down one hiker who is still unaccounted for and may have been hiking in the Grand Canyon’s lower rim when dangerous flood floods swept through the popular area. It comes as officials confirm they have discovered the bodies of two men. Crews are now assessing the catastrophic damage, including to a pipe system that carries fresh water. NBC’s Dana Griffin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Death Toll in Nepal Reaches Grim Milestone as it Tops 1,000
headlines.description: Nearly a week after catastrophic floods hit Nepal, the death toll there has crossed 1,000 with the dead being laid to rest in mass graves. Meanwhile, rescue teams are continuing to dig in search for thousands more missing. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: ICE arrests 50,000 people in August, continuing record pace
headlines.description: ICE is in the midst of a nationwide arrest surge that is not as visible as aggressive enforcement efforts from earlier in 2026.

headlines.title: Record baby boom brings world’s heaviest parrot back from the brink
headlines.description: There’s been a baby boom among one of the world’s most endangered parrot species - and it’s something to crow about.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Massachusetts primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Massachusetts, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Bond yields surge and stocks tumble as inflation fears ripple through markets
headlines.description: Bond yields surged and stock markets opened lower amid growing concerns that the Fed will raise interest rates this month to combat persistent inflation.

headlines.title: Woman killed in Times Square stabbing spree identified as 32-year-old from New Jersey
headlines.description: Authorities have released the identity of the woman killed when police say an emotionally disturbed woman started stabbing people in the heart of Times Square Monday afternoon.
